integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model equations and the cholera-free threshold/stability sections. The proof is analytic and the bundled exact-arithmetic check only verifies a concrete admissible witness. The next-generation method paper and a related cholera-vaccination model were compared at the level of assumptions and implications. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to the autonomous system exactly as printed and the nondegenerate regime \(\alpha\Pi\eta>0\), \(0<p<1\), and \(\mu>0\).
It does not determine the existence, uniqueness, or stability of a positive endemic equilibrium.
It does not analyze a corrected model in which vaccinated-to-infectious transfer depends on exposure, nor the controlled system after its equations are modified.
title: The autonomous SVITR cholera model has a positive infective floor
